findings.spec_constraint: Varchar(35) in legal text vs Varchar(100) in field specifications
findings.source_values: Field Spec Row 290: Varchar(100); Legal Doc p.107: Varchar(35)
findings.reasoning: HKMA defines the field 'Package identifier' to link transactions executed as a single package. However, the legal consultation text restricts the field to Varchar(35) (up to 35 characters), which conflicts with the CR requiring support for up to 50 characters. Although the field specification allows Varchar(100), the sources disagree and the 35-character constraint fails the requirement.
